name: Tawaramoto (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tawaramoto town emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Tawaramoto, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1958.

features.role: Tawaramoto town emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars
